categories.main_business_segments: J&V Energy Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in renewable energy sectors including solar power (rooftop, ground-mounted, floating, and agrivoltaic systems), offshore wind power development, green electricity sales platforms, energy storage systems, water treatment (industrial wastewater recycling, sewage treatment, seawater desalination), and biomass energy. The company also engages in energy technology services and investment in related subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced solar photovoltaic technologies including high-efficiency modules and thin-film solar panels, offshore wind farm development expertise, integrated energy storage system design and construction, and water treatment technologies compliant with environmental regulations. It emphasizes project management, engineering design, procurement, construction, and operation & maintenance services, leveraging international technical partnerships and local expertise.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial and commercial enterprises, government agencies, and utility companies in Taiwan. The company serves sectors such as manufacturing, semiconductor, electronics, finance, and public infrastructure, providing green electricity supply contracts and renewable energy project development. It also targets large electricity consumers mandated by regulations to adopt renewable energy or purchase green power certificates.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan, with significant project sites in regions such as Yunlin, Yilan, Tainan, Chiayi, Pingtung, Kaohsiung, and Changhua. It is expanding offshore wind power development in the Taiwan Strait and plans to extend offshore wind projects into the Asia-Pacific region, including Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: J&V Energy Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the renewable energy supply chain, focusing on project development, engineering, procurement, construction, operation, and maintenance of renewable energy power plants. It also engages in energy sales and integrated service provision, acting as a renewable energy integrator rather than a manufacturer of core equipment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes expanding its renewable energy portfolio with a focus on solar, offshore wind, energy storage, and water treatment. It aims to develop integrated renewable energy solutions, including combining solar with storage systems and promoting small-scale storage for commercial and residential use. It plans to enhance ESG compliance, develop carbon management services, and pursue overseas market expansion, especially in Asia-Pacific offshore wind projects.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through engineering project contracts (turnkey EPC services), electricity sales from owned and operated renewable energy plants, consulting and labor services, and sales of related equipment components. The company also earns income from green electricity sales contracts with corporate clients and government entities, and from energy storage system installations and operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading integrated renewable energy service provider in Taiwan, leveraging a one-stop service model and strong project execution capabilities. It competes with other domestic renewable energy developers and service providers, as well as international players in offshore wind and solar sectors. Its strategic alliances, extensive project portfolio, and partnerships with global firms like BlackRock and Stonepeak enhance its competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: J&V Energy Technology has shown rapid growth, with consolidated revenue increasing from approximately NT$2.15 billion in 2021 to NT$6.3 billion in 2022, a 192% increase. Operating profit grew 274% to NT$876 million, and net profit doubled to NT$471 million. The company’s asset base expanded significantly, with total assets reaching over NT$8.2 billion in 2022. It maintains a healthy financial structure with increasing retained earnings and ongoing capital investments in renewable energy projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive one-stop integrated renewable energy services, combining development, construction, operation, and maintenance with green electricity sales and energy storage solutions. It differentiates through strong project management, technical expertise, and strategic partnerships with international investors and technology providers. Its focus on innovative agrivoltaic projects, large-scale offshore wind development, and ESG-driven water treatment solutions positions it as a sustainable and reliable green energy partner.
